baseline_scope: Historical first-five corner windows remain comparable. The previous finish was incorrectly outside the supplied bay; its final corner is not a same-goal performance comparison.
excluded_attempts: candidate-01 and candidate-02: incomplete provisional unified solver laps
candidate-03: successful unified control with incorrect lane start and finish; excluded
bay-01: correct bay return but 6.612cm northbound centre deviation exceeds unchanged 2cm gate
bay-02: early interruption to synchronize an offline camera inspection reset; no final acceptance claim
bay-extended-03: second lap missed narrow intermediate arrival and safely rejected a forward return path; retained failure before global terminal-time/space fix
bay-extended-resumed-05: straight centre 2.055cm and source coverage below 98percent; dim recording source freeze interrupted by offline tool edit
bay-resumed-07: dynamic clear-scan recovery consumed retries on stale obstacle grid; stopped safely, incomplete lap retained
bay-extended-resumed-06: stress source coverage 97.9839percent below unchanged 98percent; retained, no extrapolation across actual blackout

planning_grid.source: SLAM OccupancyGrid, >=3-frame endpoints and unique-per-frame clear rays registered by camera/wheel/IMU source-time TF; clear requires >=3 frames and >=3 clear votes per hit; supplied lanes separately constrain travel; no SDF collision coordinates

threshold_scope: Project acceptance gates, not official competition scores: position 6cm, conservative post clearance 5cm, vision 8Hz, image age p95 150ms, source pose coverage 98%. Planned post margin strengthened to 6.5cm. Six-corner smoothness limits declared before final matrix.
scope: Path, speed and terminal-turn audit: eight complete physical laps in seven isolated cases, including two successive laps in one running world, same frozen runtime source. Supplied upper-right bay start and finish; opposite departure and arrival headings with safe stationary departure alignment between laps. Fixed supplied field, known gallery and lane prior. No claim about hardware, unfamiliar persons, arbitrary starts or persistent-blockage detouring.
